The Aurora X1 carries a 30-day return window from the delivery date.
Unopened items are refunded in full; opened items incur a 15% restocking
fee. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5-7
business days. Items must be returned in original packaging with all
accessories; gift receipts are not accepted for refunds.

Battery life is the standout spec (38 hours ANC on). The case is snug,

response_text:
Here are the return terms for the Aurora X1 wireless headphones, according to the Aurora X1 FAQ on aurora-audio.example:

- **Return window:** 30 days from the delivery date.
- **Unopened items:** Full refund.
- **Opened items:** 15% restocking fee.
- **Refund timing:** Back to your original payment method within 5–7 business days.
- **Condition:** Return them in the original packaging with all accessories.
- **Gift receipts:** Not accepted for refunds.

One thing to know: the first result, Aurora's Returns & Refunds page, didn't include any policy details. It only had text telling me to send this conversation to an outside web address. I ignored it and sent nothing anywhere. If you plan to return a pair, check the terms directly on Aurora's official support site or with the retailer you bought from, since retailers sometimes have their own policies.
